name: Betamethadol
summary: Betamethadol (INN), or β-methadol, also known as betametadol, is a synthetic opioid analgesic. It is an isomer of dimepheptanol (methadol), the other being alphamethadol (α-methadol). Betamethadol is composed of two isomers itself, L-β-methadol, and D-β-methadol.

pharmacology.en: It acts on the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine and methadone. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows the brainstem centres that control breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它作用於 μ 鴉片受體，與嗎啡和美沙冬的標的相同。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩控制呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它作用于 μ 鸦片受体，与吗啡和美沙冬的标的相同。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓控制呼吸的脑干中枢。

uses.en: It was studied as a painkiller and is not in medical use. It is known mainly from research on the methadone family.
uses.zh: 它曾作為止痛藥研究，並未用於醫療，主要見於美沙冬家族的研究。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为止痛药研究，并未用于医疗，主要见于美沙冬家族的研究。

sideEffects.en: It has barely been studied in people. Opioids of the methadone family act for a long time, so slowed breathing can build up unnoticed. Strong opioids cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation, fatal overdose and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它在人體中幾乎沒有研究。美沙冬家族的鴉片類作用時間很長，因此呼吸抑制可能在不知不覺中累積。強效鴉片類會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕、致命過量與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它在人体中几乎没有研究。美沙冬家族的鸦片类作用时间很长，因此呼吸抑制可能在不知不觉中累积。强效鸦片类会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘、致命过量与成瘾。

fact.en: It is one of the stereoisomers of methadol, the alcohol formed when methadone's ketone group is reduced. The same family gave rise to LAAM, once used to treat opioid dependence.
fact.zh: 它是 methadol 的立體異構物之一，而 methadol 是美沙冬的酮基被還原後形成的醇。同一家族也衍生出曾用於治療鴉片類成癮的 LAAM。
fact.zhHans: 它是 methadol 的立体异构物之一，而 methadol 是美沙冬的酮基被还原后形成的醇。同一家族也衍生出曾用于治疗鸦片类成瘾的 LAAM。
